event_text: The hospital says two of its email addresses were used to send mass emails to staff, and that no sign of a compromise has been found so far
Egora, citing Sud Ouest and French Breaches, reports that Scarlettgroup claims the attack
The hospital says its investigations confirmed a compromise of its information system; ANSSI informed, the CNIL notified, a complaint to follow
The Record reports the Bordeaux incident alongside attacks on the Guadeloupe hospital and the National Cancer Institute
